relocation_line: I will relocate to Toowoomba for this role and can start two weeks after an offer.
cover_letter_text:
Please accept my application for the Graduate Civil Engineer role in Toowoomba. Your advert describes site inspections, Inspection and Test Plans, daily progress reporting and drawing review under experienced project managers and site engineers, and that is the work I want to grow in.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019), and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia. In that course I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards, and prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring, reviewed drawings, tracked procurement and materials, prepared site, material and progress reports, and worked with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to sort out site issues.

I have not worked on water infrastructure yet, and I would learn your Integrated Management System and Tier 1 reporting from the team. I live in Melton, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, am available for regional site work and am open to discussing relocation to Toowoomba.

My resume is attached, and I would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
